facts.statement: Snow Days holiday events ran every day from December 18, 2009 to January 3, 2010, including community events and JCC tournaments.
facts.quote: Todos los días a partir del 18 de diciembre del 2009 hasta el 3 de enero del 2010

facts.statement: Snow Days outfits were offered for a limited time to help players get into the holiday spirit.
facts.quote: Por un tiempo limitado podrás obtener trajes especiales de Días de Nieves

article_summaries.title: Eventos y Actividades en Días de Nieve (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post announcing Snow Days (Días de Nieve) holiday events in Free Realms, running daily from December 18, 2009 to January 3, 2010. It describes daily community events at 15:00 Pacific time, all-day trading card game (JCC) tournaments, and how players find the event calendar in the in-game Game Guide. The post is dated only relatively ('1 year, 5 months ago' at capture in June 2011), so the exact posting date is unknown.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (En el Catálogo de Compra – Trajes Días de Nieve)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post announcing that Snow Days (Días de Nieve) outfits are on sale for a limited time in the Free Realms Catalog. It explains how to reach the Catalog through the in-game shopping cart and toolbar, where Snow Days items are filed, and that items are bought with Station Cash. The page gives no exact prices or end date.
